subtitle: Live shells on a selection of VMs. Build the scope, connect, then work — per pane for one host, or through a tab's input for the whole group.
scopeTitle: Select the VMs for this session
scopeHint: Combine criteria — between different criteria AND, within a list OR. Nothing connects until you press Connect.
scopeSidRegexHint: RE2 over the SID, full match
scopeEmpty: Set at least one criterion to see what it matches.
groupsHint: Define groups yourself — write a query or click one together. Each group becomes a tab with its own command input.
groupsEmpty: No groups yet. Add one, or split by a field above.
autoSplitHint: creates one group per value — edit them afterwards
fontSizeTitle: {{size}}px — smaller fits more output per pane
soulsUnavailable: Souls list unavailable — the scope cannot be resolved right now.
noneSelected: No hosts selected — tick at least one console to send to.
broadcastHint: Enter here sends to every console in the active tab · type inside a pane to reach only that host · Esc leaves an expanded pane
reconnectHint: sessions are not resumed, reconnecting opens fresh shells
tooManyWarning: {{count}} consoles. Interactive sessions are meant for tens, not hundreds — narrow the scope if the wall gets slow.
mockBanner: Mock transport: these shells are simulated in the browser and are not attached to real hosts.
